newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks sharply lower at opening.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks sharply lower at opening.

text.p: Wall Street stocks fell sharply in nervous early trading on Monday ahead of Tuesday's Federal Reserve meeting on interest rates.
All Dow industrial components traded lower, with the Dow industrials average off 30 at 5,858. The NASDAQ Index was off six at 1,214, while the S&P Index fell 3.5 to 683.5.
The long bond was off 1/32 to yield 7.05 percent.
